title: Clinical records

sharingHint: Clear a guardian’s selection to withdraw access.

episodeSharing: Selected guardians can see the final status and summary. Ward, procedure, and recovery notes stay in the clinic chart.
signature: Saving signs this version with your staff account. Review the event time and details before signing.

eventOrder: Enter an event time on or after the previous entry.
